title: 第三章 再度精进第四章 狂飙演技
content_zh:
第三章：再度精进杜如年被吓得一个激灵，闭上眼道：“是二少爷的母亲柳媚儿，她说苏家未来必须交到二少爷手里。但苏家家传向来都是传长不传次，因此大少爷必须死，这才让我安排人去对付大少爷。”
一把揪住杜如年的领口，苏命冷声道：“所以，当初苏命中毒瘫痪，也是你们的手笔？”
“天地良心，这可不关我的事儿啊。”杜如年摇头如拨浪鼓道：“当初下毒的事儿是二少爷亲手做的，我就是跑个腿儿送个信儿，具体的事情跟我没有关系。”
“我只是大概知道，当初对大少爷下毒，好像是因为老爷向天剑宗买了一个外门弟子的位置，老爷想把大少爷送进天剑宗历练历练。可那个位置，二少爷也看上了。”
“位置只有一个，二少爷想去天剑宗，那就只能对大少爷下手了……”
苏命皱起双目，忽然间什么都明白了。
记忆中，苏命瘫痪后不久，他那同父异母的弟弟苏权便成为了天剑宗弟子。
最可怜的是，当时他还在想，自己虽然废了，但至少，苏家还有自己的弟弟苏权。
他进入了天剑宗，未来前途无量，一定可以代替他撑起苏家……
“呵呵……”嘴里发出如枯树皮摩擦一般的阴沉低笑，笑声在黑暗的柴房中显得是那么落寞、悲凉。
上一辈子，自己被自己的道侣、兄弟迫害。
这一世，又被家人兄弟坑杀。
这世道，待他何其残忍。
拳头悄然紧握，指甲嵌入肉里也毫无感觉。仰起头，苏命心中暗自咆哮。
“兄弟害我？道侣弃我？手足兄弟欲杀我？”
“既如此，从今而后，我苏命再无兄弟、再无道侣、再无手足。”
“我会重新归来，那一日，所有欠债之人，都会让你们用鲜血来洗刷。”
见苏命只是冷笑而不说话，杜如年彻底慌了神，他担心苏命会对他下手，旋即连忙道：
“好汉，我知道你是为了大少爷而来，如果你是想为大少爷报仇的话，我这里倒是有一条消息。”
“我听说，二少爷已经晋升天剑宗内门弟子，半月之后将回潜龙城探亲。”

“半个月吗？”苏命眯起双眼，浑身杀意沸腾。
“该说的我都已经说了，您能不能饶了我，我家里上还有八十岁的老母，下还有……”
“砰！”一声闷响，杜如年的声音戛然而止。
看着已经陷入昏迷的杜如年，苏命目光复杂。
之所以不杀他，不光是因为他解开了自己心中的疑惑，同样，也是不想打草惊蛇。
身边侍卫和侍女接连被杀，幕后之人必定有所警觉。
而他现在才筑基四层，修为还太低。
这种时候太引人注目，并非好事。
收回目光，苏命转身，几个腾挪消失在夜幕之中。
……
回到后院，苏命在侍女和侍卫两人身上略微搜刮了一番，只找到三枚散碎的灵石和一些普通的银票。
随手将两具尸体丢出屋外，苏命手握灵石，闭目盘坐修炼起来。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Re-improving Du Runian was so frightened that he closed his eyes and said, "It's Liu Mei'er, the second young master's mother. She said that the Su family must be handed over to the second young master in the future. But the Su family has always passed down the family tradition, so the eldest young master must die. That's why I arranged for someone to deal with the eldest young master."
Grabbing Du Runian's collar, Su Ming said coldly: "So, it was your fault that Su Ming was poisoned and paralyzed?"
"Conscience of heaven and earth, this has nothing to do with me." Du Runian shook his head like a rattle and said: "The second young master did it himself, I was just running an errand to deliver a message. The specific matter has nothing to do with me."
"I only know roughly that the reason why I poisoned the eldest young master was because I bought a position as an outer disciple from Tianjian Sect. I wanted to send the eldest young master to Tianjian Sect for training. But the second young master also liked that position."
"There is only one position. If the second young master wants to go to Tianjian Sect, then he can only attack the eldest young master..."
Su Ming wrinkled his eyes and suddenly understood everything.
In my memory, shortly after Su Ming became paralyzed, his half-brother Su Quan became a disciple of the Tianjian Sect.
The most pitiful thing was that at that time he was still thinking that although he was useless, at least the Su family still had his younger brother Su Quan.
He has entered the Tianjian Sect and has a bright future. He will definitely be able to support the Su family on his behalf...
"Haha..." A gloomy chuckle came out of his mouth, like the friction of dry tree bark. The laughter seemed so lonely and sad in the dark woodshed.
In my previous life, I was persecuted by my Taoist companions and brothers.
In this life, he was tricked and killed by his family and brothers again.
This world was so cruel to him.
His fists were clenched quietly, and he couldn't feel his nails digging into his flesh. Raising his head, Su Ming roared secretly in his heart.
"Brothers harmed me? Taoist companions abandoned me? Brothers and sisters want to kill me?"
"In this case, from now on, I, Su Ming, will have no brothers, no Taoist companions, and no more siblings."
"I will come back again, and on that day, all the debtors will be washed away with your blood."
Seeing that Su Ming just sneered and said nothing, Du Runian was completely panicked. He was worried that Su Ming would attack him, so he quickly said:
"Good man, I know you are here for the eldest young master. If you want to avenge the eldest young master, I have a piece of news here."
"I heard that the second young master has been promoted to an inner disciple of Tianjian Sect and will return to Qianlong City to visit relatives in half a month."
"Half a month?" Su Ming narrowed his eyes, filled with murderous intent.
"I've said everything that needs to be said. Can you please spare me? I have an eighty-year-old mother at home, and..."
"Bang!" Du Runian's voice stopped abruptly with a muffled sound.
Looking at Du Runian who had fallen into a coma, Su Ming's eyes were complicated.
The reason why he didn't kill him was not only because he solved the doubts in his heart, but also because he didn't want to alert the enemy.
The guards and maids around him were killed one after another, and the people behind the scenes must be alert.
And he has only built the fourth level of foundation now, and his cultivation level is still too low.
Being too conspicuous at this time is not a good thing.
Withdrawing his gaze, Su Ming turned around and disappeared into the night with a few moves.
…
Back in the backyard, Su Ming searched the maid and the guard for a while, only finding three scattered spiritual stones and some ordinary silver notes.
After casually throwing the two corpses out of the house, Su Ming held the spirit stone in his hand, closed his eyes and sat cross-legged to practice.
